copy.text2: We design the future of creative work. AI-powered tools to structure, collaborate, and scale without limits.
copy.text4: Our mission is to build AI-powered productivity systems that help you take back control of your time.
copy.text6: Miiles began in 2019 as Miiles Creative Studio
copy.text7: , a small studio in Mexico City founded by Miiles Horton with a clear idea: help local businesses build brands that could truly compete. Identity, design, positioning. Nothing more, nothing less.
copy.text8: The portfolio kept growing. ERPxtender, TikTok, BeeSpeaker, Naabi Kanabi. Each client added perspective on how businesses really operate and where they get stuck.
copy.text9: In 2024, Miiles launched Auto-flex, a venture focused on automated, flexible businesses, taking its first step into AI. It was not a marketing pivot. It was the start of a transformation that would shape Miiles AI just months later.
